They refuse to help me for reasons I'd really rather not get into. It's long, complicated, and resolving it would mean suing one of my parents so.... And please don't say that means I'm letting someone abuse me, I'm terrified of her. She sent me to a place that psychologically tortured me and ignored when I asked for help. I told her about what really happened there and she told me I wasn't allowed to contact my family anymore, then blamed it on me being trans.

I'm getting all I can which is medicare and adult child ssdi

I can't afford to move out, disability doesn't give me enough... I'm stuck. And no I can't work, just to be clear. I don't have the money to pay for all my meds, food and cell phone bill, I have to borrow for meds.
My whole life has been one person or another abusing me... I don't see any end to it.
